brief_summary: We conducted a triple-blind clinical trial on 92 patients in 2019. They were randomly divided into a control group of 49 patients and a treatment group of 43 patients. Treatment group received Lesstat and placebo group received the same color tablets
brief_title: Effect of Red Yeast Rice Beside Statin on Lipid Profile

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Having serum levels of LDL cholesterol (LDL-C) at least 100 mg/dL and being treated with any group of statins for at least 3 months prior to the trial.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having very high serum levels of LDL-C (above 200 mg/dL)
* Hypersensitivity to orlistat
* Using other lipid-lowering agents with statins
* History of liver disease
* Pregnancy.

official_title: Does Adding Red Yeast Rice to Statin Can Improve Lipid Profile or Vascular Inflammation? A Randomized Clinical Trial
